title: Publishing agenda
description: What gets published and when: recipes, reviews, guides, articles and social posts. Shared by editors and admins.

cadence.title: Suggested pace
items: 1 recipe a week, alternating sweet and savory.
1 review with milicitos every two weeks.
1 management article a month that uses one of the site's calculators.

release.title: When each change goes live
release.staging: Staging (this site) updates a few minutes after a change is approved: that is where to check it.
release.next: Next stable release: what is approved by {cutoff} goes out on {publish} (Madrid time).

cms-note: The agenda organizes what goes out and when. The content (texts and photos of recipes and articles) is written in the CMS.
